paper.title: The First Circumstellar Disk Imaged in Silhouette at Visible Wavelengths with Adaptive Optics

notes: Silhouette (absorption) disk in the Orion Nebula seen against the nebular H-alpha background; first circumstellar disk imaged in silhouette from the ground with adaptive optics (Follette et al. 2013, Magellan MagAO/VisAO SDI). Distance = Orion Nebula Cluster (~414 pc). Added 2026-07-11.
